subject: MAP draft & stakeholder RACI - Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & stakeholder RACI - Acme Analytics

Thanks again for a productive discovery today — appreciate you walking us through Acme's key priorities for Q2. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: Replace current on-prem inference infra to reduce per-token cost and hit 100ms 95th pct latency on customer-facing features.
- Scope: Prioritize chat and embeddings for the search/QA workflow; pilot on staging, then phased prod rollout for 100k DAU.
- Constraints: Data residency (US-only), SOC 2 evidence required for procurement, procurement timeline ~3–4 weeks.

Attached is our initial Mutual Action Plan (Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and a tentative close date. Please review the stakeholder RACI section — we listed contacts from today's call but want you to confirm the economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, and engineering lead so we can lock responsibilities and timelines.

Key proposed milestones (high level):
- Technical deep-dive with engineering (target: 2026-02-26) — owner: Redwood SE
- Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence share (target: 2026-02-28) — owner: Redwood security
- Procurement terms & SOW draft (target: 2026-03-08) — owner: Acme procurement + Redwood sales
- Pilot sign-off & QPS validation (target: 2026-03-15) — owner: Acme eng + Redwood infra
- Target contract close (target: 2026-03-18)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholder mapping (economic buyer / security owner / legal owner / eng lead) and whether the target close date above looks feasible? Also flag any dependencies we missed.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP after your confirmation and send calendar invites for the technical session.

Best,
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben — great summary. Per our internal alignment, here are the stakeholder confirmations and a few notes on dependencies: 

Stakeholder RACI (confirmed):
- Economic buyer: Tom Ellis, VP Product <tom.ellis@acme-corp.com>
- Security owner: Priya Shah, Director InfoSec <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
- Legal owner: Ken Moore, Sr. Counsel <ken.moore@acme-corp.com>
- Engineering lead: Diego Ramirez, Eng Manager <diego.ramirez@acme-corp.com>

Procurement lead is Julie Park (julie.park@acme-corp.com) — she’ll handle contract timelines and needs SOC2 + data residency language before signing. We have an internal compliance review window the week of 3/1 that could be a gating factor.

Target close date: 2026-03-18 looks reasonable from a product/exec perspective, provided procurement/CRO cycles don’t extend.

Dependencies / asks for Redwood: 
- SOC2 summary + evidence (pdf) — can you share by 2026-02-28?
- Clarify data residency options (US-only hosting + VPC option) and whether Redwood will sign a reasonable Data Processing Addendum (DPA).
- Technical deep-dive: Diego asked for an agenda focusing on latency SLAs, KV cache and token cost tradeoffs, and integration points for our auth flow.

I’m attaching a short vendor checklist the procurement team uses (SOC2-summary.pdf). We’ll schedule Diego for the technical call — is 2026-02-26 still open on your side?

Thanks,
Aisha Khan

- Solution engineering / technical lead for deep-dive: Rishi Malhotra — schedule & run the latency/cost deep-dive; prepare short benchmark notes and KV/cache explanation.
- Security deliverables owner: Monica Patel (Security PM) — send SOC2 summary, compliance artifacts, and DPA language.
- Legal / procurement support: Marissa Cole — coordinate SOW and procurement asks, loop in legal when redlines appear.

Milestone RACI (proposed):
- 2026-02-26: Technical deep-dive (Rishi SE) — agenda: latency targets, integration auth, pilot scope (30-min demo + 30-min Q&A).
- 2026-02-28: Deliver SOC2 summary + DPA template (Monica)
- 2026-03-08: Draft SOW & commercial terms (Ben/Marissa)
- 2026-03-15: Pilot validation / sign-off criteria confirmed (Rishi + Acme eng)
- 2026-03-18: Target contract signature (Ben / Tom Ellis)

I’m adding the HubSpot MAP doc to the deal record and will upload the updated MAP after Ben’s next version. Ben — once Aisha confirms Diego’s availability, can you lock the 2/26 call and I’ll prep SOW template?
